skills.name: admin-mcp-usage
skills.description: Use when reporting on MCP tool usage — how many MCP calls were made over a period, which tools or methods were used most, or a per-date breakdown of who used what and when.

skills.name: browse-recognition-feed
skills.description: Use when browsing the company recognition feed — seeing what recognition is happening across the company, filtering the feed by hashtag, department, location, team, recognition type, or a specific giver or receiver.

skills.name: claim-incentive
skills.description: Use when you want to claim a claimable award ("incentive") for yourself — a self-service achievement, milestone, or perk you've earned in Bonusly.

skills.name: explore-org-chart
skills.description: Use when exploring the reporting hierarchy, finding who someone reports to, listing a person's full management chain, mapping the team beneath a manager, finding groups, or finding top-level employees with no manager.

skills.name: find-unrecognized-employees
skills.description: Use when a manager or admin wants to find employees who haven't received recognition recently, identify participation gaps, or see who's been left out across a team, department, or the whole company.

skills.name: give-recognition
skills.description: Use to give recognition to one or more colleagues (or a group) through Bonusly, and to edit or undo a recognition you just gave within the short editing window.

skills.name: manage-awards
skills.description: Use when creating, updating, reviewing, or retiring custom awards — spot bonuses, peer awards, claimable achievements, or any special recognition type beyond everyday recognition.

skills.name: manage-giving-balances
skills.description: Use when checking a user's giving balance, granting a points boost or allowance, topping up someone's giving balance, or adjusting how many points a user has to give.

skills.name: my-redemptions
skills.description: Use when someone wants to see their own reward redemptions — what they've redeemed, the status of a reward, where a gift card or claim link is, or whether a redemption went through.

skills.name: offboard-employee
skills.description: Use when an employee is leaving the company, deactivating or archiving a user, removing someone from Bonusly, or reactivating a previously deactivated account.

skills.name: onboard-new-hire
skills.description: Use when adding a new employee to Bonusly, creating a new user account, inviting a new hire, or setting up someone who just joined the company.

skills.name: one-on-ones
skills.description: Use when a user asks about their one-on-ones or 1:1 meetings in Bonusly — including listing upcoming or past meetings, finding out who they have meetings with, reviewing meeting summaries, reading transcripts, or looking up meeting notes from a specific conversation.

skills.name: participation-report
skills.description: Use when pulling a recognition participation report, checking giving or receiving rates by department, location, or manager team, or identifying which groups are least engaged in recognition.

skills.name: process-redemptions
skills.description: Use when reviewing or processing pending reward redemptions — approving, declining, fulfilling, or refunding custom reward requests from employees.

skills.name: recognition-history
skills.description: Use when someone wants to see their own or a colleague's recognition history — what they've received, given, when they were last recognized, or to search recognitions by theme or keyword.

skills.name: recognize-my-team
skills.description: Use when a manager wants to recognize their direct reports, check who they haven't recognized recently, or send team-wide recognition.

skills.name: rewards-spend-report
skills.description: Use when reporting on reward spend, pulling redemption totals or detail, checking how many points have been redeemed by department or country, or reviewing the rewards budget without taking action on individual redemptions.

skills.name: update-employee
skills.description: Use when changing an existing employee's profile — reassigning their manager, moving them to a different department or location, granting or revoking admin access, fixing their name, email, locale, or time zone, or other reorg and correction edits.
